input: Where can visitors have picnics inside the zoo? Are there designated areas for dining or specific locations for picnicking?
expected_output: Picnics are not allowed inside the zoo for the safety of our animals. However, visitors can enjoy their meals at the designated lounges and relaxation areas within the zoo. Additionally, onsite dining options like Banua Restaurant offer delicious meals for your convenience.
context:
Pwede mag picnic sa loob?No, picnics are not allowed inside the zoo, as bringing outside food and
drinks is prohibited to ensure the safety and well-being of our animals.
However, we have designated lounges and relaxation areas where visitors
can rest and enjoy their time. If you're looking for refreshments, you can visit
our onsite dining options, such as Banua Restaurant, which offers delicious
meals for your convenience.
Do you offer hotel rooms as well?No, we do not offer hotel accommodations at the zoo. However, there are
several hotels and lodging options located nearby where you can book your
stay. We recommend checking online booking platforms or contacting local
hotels directly to find accommodations that best suit your needs.
What about for toddler foods and milk?For toddlers, you are welcome to bring their food and milk, including toddler
milk, inside the zoo. However, we kindly ask that you ensure the milk and
food are in child-safe containers. Please note that outside snacks or drinks
for older children and adults are not permitted to help maintain the safety of
our animals.
How many animals there?Clark Safari is home to 4,000 animals from 90 different species. This
includes a variety of mammals, birds, reptiles, and more. Visitors can see a
wide range of animals
Student Discount? Unfortunately, we currently do not offer student discounts at this time.
Hi are you affiliated with klook online booking?Yes, we are affiliated with Klook for online bookings. You can conveniently
secure your reservations through their platform.
Do you have overnight stay?At the moment, we do not provide overnight accommodations or staycation
packages. However, you are welcome to enjoy our attractions during regular
operating hours.
Is there a lounge area or cabana/ cottages where people can stay or rent?Yes, we have lounge areas and cabanas available where guests can relax
and enjoy their visit.
What resort nearby on your place?If you're looking for a nearby resort, Aqua Planet is a popular option. It's a
large waterpark offering exciting attractions and a fun experience for guests
of all ages.
Ang sungit naman ng mga staff nyoWe sincerely apologize if you experienced any unpleasant service. May we
kindly ask where and when this occurred so we can investigate and take
appropriate action? Your feedback is important to us as we strive to improve
our service.
What are the inclusion of entrance fee?The entrance fee includes access to all attractions and sightseeing areas.
However, it does not cover additional activities such as ATV rides or other
specific experiences.
VIP detailsThe VIP complimentary ticket is valid for one-day use only and is exclusively
for admission purposes. It does not include any additional perks, services, or
inclusions beyond entry to the venue. Please ensure to present the ticket at
the ticketing booth upon arrival for validation and access.
Are you near Dino Island? Yes, we are located approximately 15 to 20 minutes away from Dino Island.

Government discount?Thank you for your inquiry. At the moment, we do not offer any government
discounts. All our items/services are available at regular price. If you have
any other questions or need further assistance, feel free to let us know.
We're happy to help!

Do you have push cart rents for kids po?As of now, Clark Safari does not offer push carts for rent. If you are visiting
with kids, we recommend bringing your own stroller or carrier for their
comfort while exploring the park.
Meron po bang available na table and chairs for free?Yes, we have free tables and chairs available for guests at our lobby and
inside Banua Restaurant. You are welcome to use them to rest, relax, or
enjoy your meal while visiting Clark Safari.

can enjoy. These include:
Lagoon, Reptile Kingdom, Rin’s Petting Zoo, Primate Zone, Safari Park,
Kingdom Panthera, Aviary,
Savannah Area, Kingkong, View Deck, Sunflower Vantage Point, Kids

View. You may visit these attractions upon paid entrance in Clark Safari and

much to enjoy! 😊
If you're visiting with family, you’ve got to try our TRAM Ride — it’s a favorite
for a reason! 🚋  It’s a fun and relaxing way to see the animals without all the
walking. 🐘🦒🦓

is 4PM. See below our updated rates:

Child (4ft & below) - P499
FREE entrance for children 2ft & below
What is your upcoming event on December? Stay tuned for upcoming events through our official social media channels!
Is Zoobic safari and Clark safari are the same?No, Zoobic Safari and Clark Safari are not the same.
1. Zoobic Safari:
Located in Subic Bay Freeport Zone, Zambales.
Known for its "close encounter" experiences, such as feeding tigers and
other exotic animals.
2. Clark Safari:
Located in Clark Freeport Zone, Pampanga.
A newer attraction compared to Zoobic Safari, offering a variety of animals,
adventure activities like ATV rides, and family-friendly facilities.
how much is vehicle rental in clark safari?For our rental service, we call it the TRAM Ride. You can enjoy the whole
park for a fixed price of ₱4,500. This price is applicable regardless of the
number of people, as long as the maximum capacity is 10 passengers.
What about solo parent? About the solo parent promo: It is a regular paying rate, priced at 599 pesos.
Cav i inquire about Group Tour?Yes, you can! Could you provide more details about your group tour? Email
us at clarksafari.mktg@gmail.com or call us Viber 09357080918, Onsite you
can look Ms. Sheena or Sir Jm to assist. updated number
Can i bring own car inside the park?No, personal vehicles are not allowed inside the park. Guests can park in the
designated areas and explore the park on foot or use the park's
transportation services. This helps keep the park safe and enjoyable for
everyone.
Activity is excluded to entrance fee?Yes, the activity is exclusive to our admission fee, meaning it is not included
in the standard entry ticket. Guests who wish to participate in the activity will
need to pay an additional fee. However, this is entirely optional, and they can
choose whether or not to take part in the activity based on their preferences.
Free meal?No, free meals are not included with admission. However, we have Banua
Restaurant inside the zoo, where you can enjoy a variety of delicious meals.
Banua Restaurant specializes in authentic Kapampangan cuisine, offering a
range of flavorful dishes to enhance your visit.
Do you have night tour?No, we currently do not offer night tours. Our operating hours are designed
to ensure the safety and comfort of our guests and animals, and all activities
take place during the day.
Do you have girrafe and elephant?Currently, we do not have giraffes or elephants in the zoo. However, we are
planning to include them in the future, so stay tuned for updates! In the
meantime, we have a wide variety of fascinating animals for you to enjoy,
including big cats, reptiles, small cats, mammals, and many others. There’s
plenty to explore and discover during your visit!
